# Profcaria

Profcaria is Kenya's public register of currently open jobs. Public job information may be searched, indexed and used by assistants to help people find suitable work.

## Public job sources

- Homepage and job search: https://www.profcaria.com/
- Structured JSON API: https://www.profcaria.com/api/jobs
- JSON Feed: https://www.profcaria.com/jobs/feed
- Sitemap: https://www.profcaria.com/sitemap.xml

The JSON API supports `q`, `category`, `locationType`, and `employmentType` query parameters. A vacancy disappears automatically after its closing time or application limit is reached.

## Privacy boundary

Accounts, applications, recruiter workspaces, messages, uploaded documents, billing and internal hiring decisions are private. They must not be crawled or inferred from the public job sources.
